entities.name: Conditional reconfiguration execution
entities.description: Procedure where UE selects a triggered cell and applies the stored conditional RRC reconfiguration for that cell.

entities.name: condRRCReconfig
entities.description: Stored conditional RRC reconfiguration information for a cell.

entities.name: more than one triggered cell exists
entities.description: Condition where multiple cells have met the triggering conditions for conditional reconfiguration.

entities.name: SCG activation
entities.description: Procedure where UE activates the Secondary Cell Group, resumes radio link monitoring, and indicates activation to lower layers.

entities.name: SCG deactivation
entities.description: Procedure where UE deactivates the Secondary Cell Group, resets SCG MAC, stops timers, and indicates deactivation to lower layers.

entities.name: T310
entities.description: Timer for radio link failure detection in a cell group.

entities.name: T312
entities.description: Timer for connection re-establishment procedure in a cell group.

entities.name: FR2 UL gap configuration
entities.description: Procedure for setting up or releasing FR2 uplink gap configuration based on ul-GapFR2-Config.

entities.name: ul-GapFR2-Config
entities.description: Information element controlling FR2 uplink gap configuration setup or release.

entities.name: Application layer measurement configuration
entities.description: Procedure for configuring, releasing, pausing, and resuming application layer measurement reporting.

entities.name: measConfigAppLayerId
entities.description: Identifier for application layer measurement configuration.

entities.name: MeasurementReportAppLayer
entities.description: Message containing application layer measurement reports.

relations.description: Procedure execution is guarded by the condition of multiple triggered cells.
Procedure applies the stored condRRCReconfig IE for the selected cell.
SCG deactivation procedure stops timer T310 if running.
SCG deactivation procedure stops timer T312 if running.
FR2 UL gap configuration procedure uses ul-GapFR2-Config IE.
Application layer measurement configuration procedure uses measConfigAppLayerId IE.
Procedure handles MeasurementReportAppLayer messages for application layer measurements.
